# Support

Fornix is an alpha open-source project building verifiable AI work
infrastructure for long-running repository operations. The most useful support
reports explain the repository-work problem, the expected safety or recovery
boundary, and the smallest redacted reproduction.

Please search existing issues and discussions before opening a new request.

- Use a GitHub issue for a reproducible bug or a focused feature proposal.
- Use GitHub Discussions for questions, design exploration, and deployment
  experience reports.
- Use the private security reporting channel described in [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md)
  for vulnerabilities, credentials, exploit details, or private data.

Support is community and maintainer driven. Include the version or commit,
the environment, a bounded reproduction, and redacted output. Never include
API keys, raw prompts, private repository contents, or unbounded provider/tool
transcripts.
